profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced back-end software developer with a strong foundation in Java and SQL, complemented by proficiency in JavaScript and React. I contribute to the creation and optimization of robust back end systems. My transition from a former high school math teacher has equipped me with exceptional problem solving skills and the ability to communicate complex concepts effectively.
